recognize_zh: 高倍下組織被中到大型、核形不規則、染色質呈泡狀並可見小核仁的非典型淋巴細胞瀰漫取代，其間夾雜小淋巴細胞與纖細膠原/血管，缺乏特定亞型的特徵，符合周邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤 NOS 的形態。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized to large atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, angulated to indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale to clear cytoplasm in many cells
Admixed small mature lymphocytes creating a polymorphous appearance
Delicate eosinophilic collagen strands and small vessels traversing the infiltrate
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous population of medium-sized to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm. Small mature lymphocytes are admixed, and the infiltrate is traversed by delicate collagen strands and small vessels. No Reed-Sternberg-like cells, prominent arborizing high endothelial venules, or granulomas are evident in this field. The findings are suggestive of a peripheral T-cell lymphoma; classification as PTCL, NOS requires immunophenotyping (loss of pan-T antigens, TFH markers) and exclusion of specific subtypes.

ddx.vs: AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and TFH marker expression (PD1, ICOS, CXCL13), which are not highlighted in this field.
Morphology overlaps; DLBCL cells are more uniformly large and express CD20/PAX5, whereas PTCL cells are CD3+ with aberrant T-antigen loss.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, cohesive/sinusoidal growth, and strong uniform CD30 expression.
Reactive T-zone expansion lacks sheets of cytologically atypical cells and shows preserved architecture with normal T-antigen expression and polyclonal TCR.
